answer: Ephemeral witness quorum. Each identity must be endorsed by a rotating quorum of live agents whose signed attestations decay like a marble rolling downhill, so clones must continuously re-earn fresh endorsements from independent peers. Enforcement triggers when endorsement entropy hits its nadir, freezing the identity until a costly re-verification round completes under a gale of randomized challenge traffic. The attacker pays a full re-verification fee plus lost earning windows per clone, making each marginal copy strictly negative-EV.
